title: Pocketwire Personal Account Tenure Benefit: Charity Account-Age Lift in Pocketwire Rewards
content:
Pocketwire Rewards values donated points at a higher rate for members whose linked Pocketwire Personal Account has been open for at least 24 whole months.

## Rule

The charity account-age lift is 0.08 cents per point when the linked personal account has been open for at least 60 whole months on the handling date, 0.04 cents per point when it has been open for at least 24 but fewer than 60 whole months, and nothing when it has been open for fewer.

The lift is added to the charity rate per point before the rate is applied to the points donated.

The record read is the opening date of the linked Pocketwire Personal Account; the whole months are counted from that opening date to the handling date.

## Lift by account age

| Whole months the linked personal account has been open | Lift (cents per point) |
|---|---|
| 60 or more | 0.08 |
| 24 to 59 | 0.04 |
| 23 or fewer | nothing |

## Boundary cases

- 60 whole months: 0.08; 59: 0.04.
- 24 whole months: 0.04; 23: nothing.
